title: routing
description: A single routing entry on a test handler (`onPass`, `onFail`, `onWarning`, `onSkip`): an optional condition (`if`) plus exactly one of `continue`, `stop` (`test` or `spec`), or `goToTest`. Step handlers take a step routing entry instead.

if.title: Condition
if.description: A condition expression, or an array of expressions combined with logical AND.

continue.description: Continue with the next test. Use to explicitly suppress a default handler behavior.

stop.description: Stop at the given scope. `test` does nothing, because the test already finished. `spec` skips the spec's remaining tests.

goToTest.description: Identifier of the test to jump to, within the same spec.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: A condition expression, or an array of expressions combined with logical AND.

step.title: Step routing
step.description: A single routing entry on a step handler (`onPass`, `onFail`, `onWarning`, `onSkip`): an optional condition (`if`) plus exactly one of `continue`, `stop` (`test`), `retry`, or `goToStep`.

if.title: Condition
if.description: A condition expression, or an array of expressions combined with logical AND.

continue.description: Continue execution with the next step. Use to explicitly suppress a default handler behavior.

stop.description: Stop the test's remaining steps in this context.

limit.description: Maximum number of retries — re-runs after the first attempt. A step that still fails after `limit` retries (so `limit + 1` total runs) falls through to the next matching handler entry or the status default. The step's `attempts` result field reports how many times it ran. Not the same as the config and context `retries` field, which re-runs a whole context on a new session.

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before each retry.

backoff.description: Backoff strategy applied to the delay between retries.

goToStep.description: Identifier of the step to jump to, within the same test.
